detailed_description: Blog Title Generator produces 10-15 headline ideas from a topic keyword, optional audience, and title style. The real component includes informative, how-to, listicle, question, and ultimate-guide modes with copy actions and character counts. Use it to compare search-focused angles, beginner-friendly titles, checklist formats, and problem-solution framing before selecting the title that best matches your article intent.
usage_steps: Enter the blog topic or keyword.
Choose the title style: informative, how-to, listicle, question, or ultimate guide.
Copy one title or copy the full list, then edit the final headline for your real article.
usage_examples: Brainstorm listicle headlines for a marketing article.
Compare how-to and question titles for the same blog topic.
Generate beginner-friendly title options for an educational post.

faqs.question: Blog Title Generator is free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool runs free in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The calculation or generation runs locally in the browser.

faqs.question: Does it write the article?
faqs.answer: No. It generates headline ideas only. Write and fact-check the article separately.

faqs.question: Are the titles AI generated?
faqs.answer: No. The component uses local title templates and your inputs to create draft headline variations.
